_doc: Curated subset of the local specimen cache used by the offline
replay tier of the project-358382 pilot evaluator.
Reality: every cached MorphoSource media on this Mac is mesh-only
(no DICOM / TIFF / NIfTI volumes). For the replay tier, the CT
side of each pair is supplied by
metadata_to_morphsource.jetstream_replay.synthetic.make_fixture_specimen,
which writes a deterministic tiny CT (default 48^3 uint16) and a
matching sphere PLY into the per-specimen layout the orchestrator
expects. The recorded JSONL fixtures in ./sessions/ capture the
Slicer-side HTTP transcript that the pilot would have produced
against a live Jetstream2 server.
Each specimen below is keyed on the *real* mesh-side media_id
from the cache; the ct_media_id is a synthetic placeholder so
the orchestrator's run-id slug stays stable across replays.
The replay test rig (Tests/test_eval_project358382.sh, RUN_REPLAY=1)
stages each per-specimen dir as:
<out_dir>/specimens/<slug>/ct_volume.nii.gz   <- synthetic
<out_dir>/specimens/<slug>/bright_seed/ct_cropped.nii.gz
<out_dir>/specimens/<slug>/bright_seed/gt_voxelized.nii.gz
and points JETSTREAM_REPLAY at sessions/<slug>.jsonl.
